To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the proposed optimization methods can be successfully used for the compensation of color contrast loss of textual information in web pages.

(1) we propose two methods, based on numerical optimization, for color contrast compensation, (2) both methods achieve good results in terms of compensation, (3) the compensation is achieved without inducing a large change in the original color of the textual information and (4) the results are comparable to other methods proposed in the literature, but they are achieved with less computational resources.

In summary, our research is concerned with
the compensation of the loss of color information in web pages for CVD users.
the problem of compensating the loss of textual color contrast in the web pages for color deficient users (CVD) using numerical optimization methods.
the development of a method for the compensation of the color contrast of the textual information in web pages, in order to make them accessible to color vision deficient people.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the CMA-ES method outperforms the other method, especially when the amount of change in original colors is not a constraint.
the CMA-ES based approach is a good choice for compensating textual color contrast in the case where a small amount of color change is allowed.
the proposed methods are efficient for color compensation in textual web pages, but they need to be adapted in order to be efficient for compensating color contrast in images.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed methods are efficient for compensating textual color contrast in web pages, and that they can be used for other color compensation applications.
, in the case of a small compensation, the proposed methods can be applied on the fly, and in the case of larger compensation, a pre-processing phase can be performed.
the proposed methods can be successfully applied for color contrast enhancement of the textual information of a web page.
The main takeaway from our work is that
it is possible to compensate the loss of color contrast in a web page in an automated way, without the need of manual intervention.
the compensation of textual color contrast can be achieved in an on-the-fly fashion with the help of optimization methods.
the compensation process does not require a large number of evaluations to achieve a good solution and the results obtained with the methods are comparable to the ones obtained by human users.
